{{Top}}
A '''V-5 transport droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] used in [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. On the ''Falcon'', the V-5 transport droid was one of its three droid computers.
